#pseudobulk
```{r}
library(DESeq2)

table(t.query.ss$celltype.specific.simple)

t.bulk <- AggregateExpression(object = t.query.ss, assays = "RNA", return.seurat = F, group.by = c("orig.merge", "celltype.specific.simple"))

t.bulk <- t.bulk$RNA

norm <- grep("Benign", colnames(t.bulk))
mal <- setdiff(grep("CTCL", colnames(t.bulk)), norm)
# 2. Extract counts for "malig" and "other" clones
malig_counts <- t.bulk[, mal]
other_counts <- t.bulk[, norm]

countdata <- as.matrix(cbind(malig_counts, other_counts))
which(is.infinite(countdata))

col_data <- data.frame(
  condition = factor(rep(c("CTCL", "Benign"), each = ncol(malig_counts))),
  sample = rep(colnames(malig_counts), 2)
)

inventory <- readxl::read_xlsx("~/ctcl.meta.4.4/CTCL_Metadata_Final.xlsx")

batch <- data.frame(sample = colnames(t.bulk))
batch$orig.ident <- word(batch$sample, 1, sep = "_")
inventory$orig.ident <- inventory$Sample
batch <- batch %>%
  left_join(inventory, by = "orig.ident")

saveRDS(countdata, file = "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/int_results/pseudobulk.countdata.rds")

countdata <- readRDS("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/int_results/pseudobulk.countdata.rds")
countdata.no.tcr <- countdata[setdiff(rownames(countdata), c(tcr_genes,ig_genes)), ]
# 3. Create a DESeq2 object
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = countdata.no.tcr,
  colData = data.frame(
    condition = factor(rep(c("malig", "nonmalig"), each = ncol(countdata.no.tcr)/2))
  ),
  design = ~ condition
)

###########################################################################
# 4. Run DESeq2
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds)

res.df <- as.data.frame(res@listData)
rownames(res.df) <- res@rownames

# Orig
res <- results(object = dds, contrast = c("condition", "malig", "nonmalig"))
res.table <- as.data.frame(res@listData)
rownames(res.table) <- res@rownames
res.table$gene <- rownames(res.table)

res.table <- res.table[order(-res.table$stat),]
res.table.ss <- subset(res.table, !is.na(stat))
res.table.ss <- res.table.ss[order(-res.table.ss$stat),]
vsdata <- vst(dds, blind = F)
res.vst.table <- vsdata@assays@data@listData[[1]]

pca.out <- plotPCA(object = vsdata, ntop = 1000, returnData = T)
DESeq2::plotPCA(object = vsdata, ntop = 500, pcsToUse = c(1,2))

res.table.ss <- res.table.ss[order(-res.table.ss$stat),]
top_genes <- c(head(res.table.ss$gene, 25), tail(res.table.ss$gene, 25))
mat <- res.vst.table[top_genes,]
pheatmap(mat, cluster_cols = F, show_colnames = F, scale = "none", cluster_rows = F)
pheatmap(mat, cluster_cols = F, show_colnames = F, scale = "row", cluster_rows = F)

```

```{r}
ctcl.up <- head(res.table.ss$gene, 100)
ctcl.down <- tail(res.table.ss$gene, 100)

table(cd4.t.cells.small$celltype.specific.malig)

ctcl.up   <- intersect(ctcl.up, rownames(cd4.t.cells.small))
ctcl.down <- intersect(ctcl.down, rownames(cd4.t.cells.small))

DefaultAssay(cd4.t.cells.small) <- "RNA"
cd4.t.cells.small <- AddModuleScore(
  object = cd4.t.cells.small,
  features = list(ctcl.up, ctcl.down),
  name = c("CTCL_UP", "CTCL_DOWN")
)

VlnPlot(cd4.t.cells.small, features = c("CTCL_UP1", "CTCL_DOWN2"), group.by = "celltype.specific.malig", pt.size = .01, alpha = .01)

```
